title: Hostel Hudugaru Bekagiddare
desc: A group of students who are suspects in a boy's hostel warden's death craft a plan to hide his corpse after they find a note left by him.

title: Aranmanai 3
desc: Jyothi, the daughter of a landlord, gets haunted by an unknown entity in her childhood. However, when the spirit begins to trouble another member of her family, she decides to uncover its identity.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: After losing to the Kauravas in a gamble, the Pandavas go into exile and endure hardship for a number of years. Upon their return, conflict arises over the dynastic succession leading to a war.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mother's wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

title: Pedda Gedda
desc: A man with mental illness becomes the sole heir to a vast inheritance and relies on the support of his kind aunt. Meanwhile, his greedy and evil relatives plot his murder.

title: Bhroona
desc: Some of the villagers chance upon the temporary absence of a woman's husband and physically assault her, unbeknownst to the dire consequence that they would have to face.

title: Sidila Mari
desc: Ganganna and Ranga share a close bond with each other but an accident between them causes Ranga to lose his life. Years later, Ranga's son seeks out Ganganna in order to exact revenge.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Rayaru Bandaru Mavana Manege
desc: Suma and Vishnu act as a married couple to please her father. However, they get into trouble when her father finds out the truth.

title: Kona
desc: Narayana and his prophetic robot discover a remote village bound by an age-old sacrificial rite. Soon, he uncovers a sinister secret trapping the villagers in an endless cycle of past and present.
